title: Room for God's Mercy to Grow

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities. If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your ancestors, and gives you the whole land he promised them, because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today—to love the Lord your God and to walk always in obedience to him—then you are to set aside three more cities. - Deut 19:7-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God looks ahead with generosity. As His people obeyed and He enlarged their territory, they were to add three more cities of refuge. As the land grew, so would the places of mercy. God wanted safety and justice to reach every corner of the land, not just the centre.

At the heart of this command God places the true motive, "to love the Lord your God and to walk always in obedience to him." The laws were never meant to be cold rules. They flowed from a relationship of love. Obedience here is the natural response of a heart that loves God, not a way of earning His favour.

This is a lovely picture of how God works. His mercy is not stingy or limited; it expands to reach more and more people. And the fitting response to His mercy is love and glad obedience. Jesus said that if we love Him, we will keep His commands, not as a burden, but as an overflow of love (John 14:15). We are called to walk always in obedience, not to earn God's love, but because we already have it in Christ. As you consider God's ever-expanding mercy, does your obedience flow from love for Him, or does it feel like a heavy duty?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does your obedience flow from love or feel like duty?
2. How have you seen God's mercy expand in your life?
3. What would it look like to walk always in glad obedience?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your mercy keeps reaching further. Let my obedience flow from a heart that truly loves You. Amen.
